findings.defect: Effect-free native transition with a bound spanner or lever required an exactly stationary clock, recreating the body/passenger publication dependency.
findings.repair: Allow the same monotonic native transition clock with present tools; keep exact native entry/owner/binding, no cock/load/effects, and exact mechanism clocks.

findings.defect: Deliberately requested first medium/heavy tool placement/reveal could pause the native clock indefinitely.
findings.repair: A non-renewing 500 ms first-join deadline restores the saved native rate when the exact owner is still verifiable. No deadline for waiting on a deliberate user gesture.

findings.defect: After native Ammo, the first bolt placement/binding could remain missing indefinitely.
findings.repair: Bound that requested first-join wait and recover within the same owner or restore native transport on expiry. No manufactured bolt, Ammo or Load effect.

findings.defect: Release before the first achieved bolt placement could replay as a later rail nock, including a raw release newer than the completed source.
findings.repair: Retire pending grasp on a valid newer/completed release; require a fresh actual regrip/release after recovery.

findings.defect: A tracking snapshot published after the caller read time could be rejected as future input, revoking a live reload.
findings.repair: Read time after acquiring the tracking snapshot. Original age, future/stale/held-input and all owner/context checks remain enforced.

findings.defect: Medium tool achieved-grip receipt omitted body-world scale; the actually placed native grip could be correct while its receipt was displaced.
findings.repair: Convert captured model grip to asset space using body scale. Actual tool placement, grip calibration and bow/camera alignment are untouched.

findings.defect: Class-15 attachment writer withdrew an unchanged achieved tool during temporary passenger/mechanism publication gaps, enabling native/VR pose switching.
findings.repair: Use existing no-write retained placement for original 80 ms only. Validate current placeTool, phase, mount state, native main+80 item, key, entity/attachment/joint, owner/context/tracking and unchanged achieved matrix; resume fresh writes on recovery. Final heavy writes also revalidate current placeTool.
